issues.problem: Line 3, `    BaseAddress = new Uri("https://api.example.com/v2")`, is the intended bug. By RFC 3986 merge rules the buggy output is `https://api.example.com/orders/42`, matching the prompt. The sandbox only ran the fixed code, so the buggy output was not machine-verified. Line 6 could also be changed to `v2/orders/42` as an alternative repair, but the prompt says the API lives at `.../v2/`, which makes line 3 the one defensible answer.
